summary: Carded from a live smoke FAIL. Affects RELEASED users (v1.3.0/v1.3.1 pin 69a43336 also has the required input). Not caused by the MPI-467 pin bump - that misreading is recorded on the card. Id claimed with exclusive mkdir per MPI-488.

Severity claim CORRECTED before any work started. The card asserted the scaled-dimension branches were silently dead; the graph has a single output node that those four nodes are upstream of, so a true drop would have failed the whole prompt - and PiD returned media on both matrices. Rejection is fact, impact is not. A shipped-vs-patched dimension comparison must settle it before a fix or a changelog line.
todo -> doing. Working the offline half only; the live GPU smoke matrix keeps the Pod. Owns the four workflow files (API + raw twins); scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs stays MPI-467's.

Severity SETTLED offline, no Pod - and it is worse than the card guessed, not milder. MpiLoadImageFromPath subclasses PreviewImage with OUTPUT_NODE=True, so the INPUT LOADER is a valid output node; it survives while every real PreviewImage is dropped. ComfyUI therefore answers 200 + node_errors and runs only the loader branch, echoing the input image back. PiD never sampled in v1.3.0/1.3.1. Root cause is a node-pack change (ba9e156) adding a required widget to graphs already frozen on disk - not the converter, the app, or the pin bump. A default does not rescue a missing key: validate_inputs tests membership before reading any default. Fix 1 applied to all 6 API nodes + their raw twins; AST sweep 6 holes at HEAD, 0 now. Fix 2 (gate 8) messaged to MPI-467.

Closed on local evidence. MpiScaledDimensions gained a required upscale_method in MpiNodes ba9e156 (2026-07-16) AFTER nvidia_pid and flow_sdxl_4k were exported, so six nodes shipped without it. A default does not rescue a missing key - execution.py:901 tests membership before reading any default. Impact was NOT the wrong resolution this card guessed: MpiLoadImageFromPath subclasses PreviewImage with OUTPUT_NODE=True, so the input loader is itself a valid output; it survived while every real PreviewImage was dropped, ComfyUI answered 200 + node_errors and ran only the loader branch, echoing the input image back. PiD never sampled in v1.3.0/v1.3.1 and the MPI-495 guard is not in that tag. Fixed in six API nodes + their raw twins (raw matters: workflow-to-api.mjs reads widgets_values positionally). Verified by an AST required-input sweep: 6 holes at HEAD, 0 now, mutation-checked. GPU re-run and gate 8 accepted by MPI-467 (message 29d60d5f); flow_sdxl_4k needs no GPU run because MPI-332 rips it.

Severity widened at close-out. The MpiNodes pin at EVERY release tag is a descendant of ba9e156, including v1.1.0 (pin aaa1d2d9, tagged 2026-07-22, six days after the input became required) - and v1.1.0 is the release whose notes ANNOUNCE the PiD upscaler. So PiD has never produced a generated image in any shipped build: 1.1.0, 1.2.0, 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 all echo the source image back. The card body and the close-out commit both say 1.3.0/1.3.1; that understates it and this event is the correction. Changes the changelog wording from a regression fix to a feature that never worked.
